description: Validate a promo code the human gave you and attach it to the cart. Returns applied=true with the new subtotal, discount, shipping and total, or applied=false with a reason — an invalid or expired code, or a bundle price in the cart that beats it (codes don't stack with bundle pricing). Codes are case-insensitive and a cart holds one: a valid new code replaces the current one, a rejected one leaves it in place; remove_promo just drops it. Needs at least one item in the cart. Never guess or try codes the human didn't give. The code is re-checked in get_order_preview and prepare_order.

code.description: Promo code exactly as the human gave it (case-insensitive).

name: apply_promo

bundle.description: Bundle price that beats the code (when applied=false for that reason).

error.description: Present when the cart is empty or code is missing.

reason.description: Why the code was rejected (when applied=false).

title: Apply promo code
